evidence.quote: Applicants with foreign education certificates must apply via uni-assist e.V.
Applicants with foreign education certificates must apply via uni-assist e.V.

notes: The programme page (en.th-wildau.de/index.php?id=30638) explicitly says 'No tuition fees (the university only charges semester fees each semester)', so no tuition fact is included; the semester contribution of 376.80 EUR on the reregistration pages applies to all students and is not a tuition fee. The DAAD page gives an application period via uni-assist of 1 May - 15 June but without a year, so no intake fact was extracted; the German page https://www.th-wildau.de/studieren-und-weiterbilden-1/bewerbung shows 01.05.2026 - 15.06.2026 for Bewerbung über uni-assist e.V., but that page does not tie the date to this programme's foreign-certificate applicants with a year, so it was left out to avoid inferring a year. The English-language requirement is stated as B2 on the DAAD page and B2.2 CEFR on the programme's own page; the quote used is the B2 one.
